Original15 restart positive identities, with every original assertion retained:
- P-R1 host: a retained creation with no local file is ABSENT_UNCLAIMED, memo HELD, one re-entry under its id; a REMOVE afterwards routes bound and completes
- P-R1b host: a claim without its file (ABSENT_CLAIMED) is a permanent CREATION_STORAGE_MISSING, never a FRESH reopen; a REMOVE closes the slot
- P-R4 host: local ADMITTED + metadata PUBLISHED (the grant CAS reply lost, owner reachable): reopen HELD, the re-grant is idempotent, SERVING and ACTIVE
- P-R5 host: retired-not-closed (CLOSE_UNRESOLVED) before the restart: inventory RETIRED, memo REMOVING, an in-flight REMOVE entry, the re-drive closes, projects STOPPED, completes the row and emits NO outcome
- P-R6 host: metadata RELEASING, crash before the tombstone: the re-entry is a permanent RESOURCE_CLOSED; the next REMOVE retires by path, closes and completes
- P-R7 host: a crash after each of the five retirement steps (R1-D) recovers idempotently
- P-R8 in-process: a COMPLETED creation row re-enters as the permanent TERMINAL memo, its REMOVE is REMOVE_COMPLETED; after a host restart the same REMOVE is NOT_FOUND (recorded honest answer)
- P-R9 host: CREATION_STORAGE_MISSING, CORRUPT_STATE and CONTENT_CONFLICT (a copied file) are permanent typed memos, no reopen, no tombstone inferred; a REMOVE closes only the storage-missing slot
- P-R11 host: a message before ready is NOT_READY + deferRetry, nothing emitted; a wake between the memo write and the re-entry finds the memo; one re-entry
- P-R12 host: a PENDING row: the REMOVE resolves the reservation first (applied -> retired, sealed -> CANCELLED, unavailable -> HELD); a restart re-enters PENDING, never CANCELLED
- P-R12c host: the REMOVE-time resolution persisted the token, crash before CLOSED: the restart re-enters a HELD founder and the REMOVE retry retires it (no orphan)
- P-R13 host: two hosts restart over the shared journal; each inventory holds only its own node's creation
- P-R14 host: a REMOVE racing the restart re-entry takes custody: the re-entry is not started, the creation link survives, one REMOVE_COMPLETED
- P-R15 process custody: no second composition runs the inventory while the owner lock is held; a failed startup cleanup keeps the lock (ledger path, labelled)
- R3-B an open-time UNAVAILABLE of a RETAINED creation is the NAMED deferral, decided by the opening module on its own owner read; distinct from the UNROUTED row
